newsitem.title: USA: Photran sees Q4 revs below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Photran sees Q4 revs below estimates.

text.p: Photran Corp said Monday it expected fourth-quarter revenues to fall below analysts' estimates because of soft demand for glass used in liquid crystal displays.
As a consequence, the company said it was accelerating efforts to bring new products to market.

"As a result of the soft market and the downtime necessary to convert production facilities to manufacture these new products, we anticipate that revenue for the fourth quarter will be substantially below earlier analyst estimates," David Stevenson, chief executive officer said in a news release.
The statement did not say how much revenue analysts were expecting, and company officials could not be reached for comment.
The company also said it expected a reduced profit margin on sales of some equipment because of a new agreement with its joint venture partner in China.
